scope: Nashville, Tennessee; public website and its linked social profiles.

metrics.label: Instagram followers shown
metrics.context: Public profile count at the snapshot; not a measure of reach or engagement.

observations.title: Explain what happens after the estimate request
observations.observed: The homepage asks for name, phone, email, estimated date, and origin ZIP. Nearby form copy does not explain the next step or response window.
observations.improvement: Add a realistic follow-up expectation. Test optional destination/move-type questions against useful inquiries and completion before expanding the form.

observations.title: Bring customer proof closer to the decision
observations.observed: The hero uses a general rating message; the fuller review section appears after substantial Nashville guide content.
observations.improvement: Test one short, attributed review and a direct review link beside the form. Keep the detailed city guides available.

sources.label: Homepage / estimate form and review placement

limitations: Public social previews and counts do not establish complete posting frequency, reach or engagement.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
